observed_caption_phrases.description: Recurring short phrases copied verbatim from the anchor Creator's own captions, in the original content language, ranked by how many distinct posts contain them. Source is creator-profile.v3 content_profile.caption_phrases. Never paraphrase, reorder, or translate these: discovery matches literally against captions, so an intent written in analyst vocabulary retrieves a pool with no same-format content in it.

content_language.description: The Creator's primary content language from the saved account profile, present only when its confidence is high or the Creator set it. A retrieval label for writing intents in the language the Creator publishes in, never a filter: never copy it into locale.language. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

accepted_languages.description: Every language the Creator's own content uses often enough to count, as the saved account profile lists it (possibly empty). Retrieval labels only. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

audience_count.description: The Creator's audience size from the saved account profile; candidate accounts far larger or smaller are not eligible. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

formats.description: The formats the Creator actually published (short_video: 180 seconds or less). Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

signature_content.description: The Creator's signature content from the saved account profile, the Creator's main item first, then heaviest first: position + 1 is the number the relevance Gate shows for an item. Seeds are optional vocabulary for queries about Request.niche; historical classes never override the current goal or require query coverage. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

seed_terms.description: Words from the Creator's own content, in its original language.

primary.description: The Creator's main signature content; it comes first.

excluded_topics.description: Topics the Creator excluded in their saved account profile, in their own words. No intent may carry one (the plan validator refuses it), the eligibility filter removes candidates that name one, and the Gate scores an item about one 0 on topic_relevance. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

market_region.description: The market the Creator set in their saved account profile. Only the default search region when the ask names none, never a filter: never copy it into locale.region. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

own_content_ids.description: Every own example post the saved account profile lists, those of signature content the Creator removed included, so the eligibility filter never recommends one back. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

profile_basis.description: Whether the attached profile carries the Creator's own edits; for the audit only. Written by the skill's driver from the profile file the host supplied, never by the model; leave it out when writing the Request.

window_policy.description: How the window was frozen by scripts/freeze_request_window.py: default_1y when the ask names no time (the last year; TikTok 180 days, its search cap), recent_90d for now / recently without a number, user_named_span for a span the user named, kept exactly.
